caller_asset_contract.notes: A caller may validate a manifest only when the licensed vendor SDK, runtime, commercial terms, rights record, locked runtime, rate cohort, parity vector and reviewed platform are all present at absolute paths and match their declared SHA-256. The package never imports, executes or redistributes the vendor engine. No upstream revision is pinned because no public source or licensable revision is recorded. Streaming and rate automation remain unverified.

required_rate_basis_points.note: Rates are integer basis points of playback speed: 10000 is 1x, 12500 is 1.25x faster and 7500 is 0.75x slower. No float is admitted so the contract stays byte-deterministic.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the licensed IRCAM SuperVP SDK or host runtime at an exact version and build; no vendor SDK, binary, plug-in, trial or checkout is present in the workspace.
Publish the exact vendor version, build number, platform artifact and per-file SHA-256; the merged evidence records only a public product description and no artifact identity.
Obtain the IRCAM Forum or direct commercial agreement that grants embedding, redistribution, output use and patent/indemnity terms; no licence text, price, quote or grant is present or recorded.
Provide a locked runtime, exact platform and offline load path; no runtime environment, lock file or platform build exists.

Provide the licensed API reference that fixes rate semantics, sample rate, channels, hop, latency, reset, flush and final-partial-window behaviour; the product description does not establish geometry.
Freeze a rights-cleared rate cohort covering 1x, rate changes, unfamiliar speech, music, silence, rebuffer, drift and the final partial window with permitted references.
Approve an exact-runtime parity vector on a frozen caller-supplied input and configuration; no vendor output or parity vector exists.
Complete opt-in adapter intake, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval; none is present and this package is off by default.

rights_gap.note: The recorded research note says SuperVP is commercial/research access through the IRCAM Forum suite, that no public open-source licence exists, that terms must be negotiated with IRCAM, and that embedding TS2 needs a separate agreement. Those statements are provenance, not a grant. No agreement, quote or entitlement was obtained.
